# Where to Watch Hope Lives


by Angel | September 1, 2026


Six high school students know what it feels like to be on the receiving end of relentless bullying. Then they find an unexpected place to belong: a new after-school support program created for students who have experienced bullying.


The program is led by a counselor who understands their pain more than they realize. He’s carrying his own grief after losing someone to the devastating effects of bullying, and helping these students forces him to confront wounds he’s tried to leave in the past. But healing isn’t easy for any of them.


[Stream Hope Lives today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/hope-lives)


### **What Is** ***Hope Lives*** **About?**


*Hope Lives* follows six teenagers navigating the aftermath of bullying as they find support and friendship through a new after-school program. Their stories are different, but their shared experiences begin to bring them together.


At the same time, the counselor leading the group must confront his own unresolved grief. The more he helps the students look toward the future, the harder it becomes to avoid the past.


Together, their stories explore what can happen when people stop trying to carry their pain alone. Friendship becomes a source of strength. Forgiveness creates room to move forward. And a group of people who once felt isolated discovers that they don’t have to face their struggles by themselves.


### **Why You Should Watch** ***Hope Lives*** ****


Bullying can leave wounds that aren’t always visible. *Hope Lives* gives those wounds a face through six young people who are each trying to find their way forward.


The film also looks at the importance of adults who are willing to step into difficult situations and show up for young people—even when they’re dealing with their own struggles. Its message isn’t that everything gets fixed overnight. It’s that healing can begin when someone feels seen, heard, and welcomed.


Angel Guild viewers have called the film “very relevant to teens today,” while another praised its messages of “forgiveness, redemption, and overcoming adversity.” Several viewers also highlighted the film’s emphasis on unity, love, and seeing others with compassion.


Most of all, *Hope Lives* is a reminder that shared pain doesn’t have to be the end of the story. Sometimes, it can be the beginning of connection.


### **Where to Watch** ***Hope Lives***


Whether you’re watching with teenagers, as a family, or simply looking for a story about resilience and the power of community, *Hope Lives* offers plenty to talk about after the credits roll.


Because sometimes hope doesn’t arrive as a big moment. Sometimes it looks like a friend sitting beside you, a counselor willing to listen, or a group of people deciding that no one should have to go through it alone.
